ui.chat.response_actions.label.role: accessible name of the hover-revealed toolbar under a settled agent response that does not close its turn (Copy alone)
ui.chat.response_actions.label.tone: noun phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.response_actions.label.note: Screen-reader only. Must differ from the closing answer's "Answer actions" toolbar, so a turn with several responses does not announce several identical toolbars.
